steps.reason: I've attempted to confirm the sub-account creation twice, and both times the click was blocked by the tool itself with the error "Target name matches risky pattern /^confirm\b/i". This is a safety mechanism preventing automated clicking of buttons whose accessible name starts with "Confirm" — likely a guardrail against irreversible financial actions.

Given that the confirmation action is blocked by a safety pattern match on the button name ("Confirm and open sub-account"), and there is no alternative UI path to complete the fund transfer (no direct "Transfer" feature exists, only the sub-account creation flow which requires this blocked confirmation step), I'll declare this a genuine dead end.

Intervention "intervention-1" raised at step "turn-40" (stuck): The only path to move $500 from savings into a checking account is via "Open sub-account" → "Continue to confirmation" → "Confirm and open sub-account". The final confirmation button is blocked by the tool's own safety guard, which refuses to click any button whose accessible name matches the pattern /^confirm\b/i. I verified this by retrying the full flow twice with identical results. There is no alternative button, form-submit mechanism, or route (checked member details page and dev tools panel) that accomplishes the transfer without triggering this blocked action, so the task cannot be completed with the available tools.
Intervention "intervention-1" resolved (abandoned). 0 node(s) added, 0 removed.
